phrase.zh: 每一次远行，都有能量的来路。
phrase.en: Every journey has an energy story.

visual.zh: 机械、轮廓与流动的带状线条连接动力和远行。它把能量传递画成可见的路径，不是某台发动机的效率图或工程剖面。
visual.en: Machinery and flowing bands connect power with travel. Energy transfer becomes a visible path, rather than an efficiency chart or a working engine section.

background.zh: NASA 的航天基础说明，火箭通过向后排出物质产生推力，体现牛顿第三定律中相互作用力大小相等、方向相反的关系。火箭不需要“推空气”才能前进，因此也能在真空中工作。
background.en: NASA’s spaceflight guide explains rocket thrust through expelling mass, illustrating equal and opposite interaction forces in Newton’s third law. A rocket does not need air to push against and can therefore operate in a vacuum.
